decisions.decision: Switched from date-fns to native Intl.DateTimeFormat to avoid adding new dependencies and fix Vite 500 errors.
decisions.trade_offs: Native Intl is slightly more verbose but avoids bundle bloat and installation issues.

decisions.decision: Implemented triple-layer protection (Backend RoleGuard, AppRouter ProtectedRoute, and Component-level useAuth check).
decisions.trade_offs: Redundant but ensures maximum security as requested by the user.

decisions.context: M0 Free-Tier Backup & Restore Architecture (TRD Steps 0.1-0.3)
decisions.decision: Atlas M0 Free Tier does not support Atlas Cloud Backup or web console snapshots. All backups, test restores, and staging clones are conducted client-side via node scripts/backup.js with compressed BSON/JSON archives (.gz) outside git tracking.
decisions.trade_offs: Requires local execution and egress bandwidth, but guarantees exact BSON type fidelity and zero cloud cost without requiring paid M10+ tier.

decisions.decision: Pushing to GitHub is strictly reserved for the human administrator. Agent commits locally on phase branches (e.g., phase-0-safety-net, phase-1-additive-schema) and never executes git push.
decisions.trade_offs: Prevents accidental CI/CD trigger or auto-deploy to live production.

decisions.decision: Implemented an in-memory 5-second TTL cache for feature flag lookups in server/src/utils/featureFlags.js with instant cache invalidation on mutations.
decisions.trade_offs: Absorbs high-volume traffic spikes while strictly respecting FR-F5 requirement that flag changes take effect within <=10s.

decisions.decision: Used text-layer PDF parsing with honorific stripping, regex table extraction, 'without teacher' exclusions, and explicit Preview -> Commit staging.
decisions.trade_offs: Guarantees zero OCR/ML hallucination, sub-second parsing time (<3s NFR-2), and prevents silent data overwrites.
